definition.source: def experiment(inputs): import random; params = inputs.get('parameters', {}); seeds = inputs.get('seeds', [333, 444, 555]); random.seed(seeds[0]); coupling = params.get('coupling', 0.85); baseline = [random.random() for _ in range(20)]; trajectory_a = [x * coupling + (random.random() * 0.05) for x in baseline]; trajectory_b = [x * coupling + (random.random() * 0.05) for x in baseline]; return {'measurements': {'divergence_variance_delta': [sum((a-b)**2 for a, b in zip(trajectory_a, trajectory_b))/len(trajectory_a)]}}
